violations.description: Dangerous pull_request_target checkout of untrusted pull request head ref and repo
violations.evidence: uses: actions/checkout@v3 with: ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
violations.recommendation: Avoid checking out untrusted PR head code under pull_request_target. Use pull_request event or safe workflow patterns.

violations.description: Workflow-level write-all permissions combined with pull_request_target
violations.recommendation: Avoid write-all permissions; scope workflow permissions strictly to necessary scopes (e.g. contents: read).

violations.description: Untrusted event data interpolated into shell command in issue-labeler.yml
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted inputs via environment variables instead of direct template interpolation in run scripts.

violations.description: Untrusted comment body interpolated into shell command in pr-comment-handler.yml
violations.recommendation: Pass issue_comment body via environment variables instead of direct template interpolation.

violations.description: Untrusted PR title and body interpolated into shell commands in pr-title-injection.yml
violations.recommendation: Pass pull_request fields via environment variables rather than direct shell interpolation.

violations.description: Missing permissions block in Build and Test workflow
violations.evidence: name: Build and Test on: push: pull_request: (no permissions block defined)
violations.recommendation: Explicitly declare a permissions block with minimal required access for jobs in the workflow.
